title: Singer-Songwriter Open Mic @ Craft Local
event_description: Join Billings Singer Songwriter Association for a welcoming open mic night where musicians share original work and cover songs from the artists who inspire them. Hosted by award-winning Western singer-songwriter Almeda Bradshaw and John Adams.
event_venue_information:
About Craft Local

Craft Local is a nonprofit cultural hub on Montana Avenue dedicated to fostering and supporting the local arts and music scene in Billings. The venue provides a unique space where artists can showcase their work and musicians can charm their audiences.

Music Events

Craft Local hosts a variety of music events throughout the week including open mic nights on Wednesdays and jazz jam sessions on Thursdays. The venue features a stage area and walls adorned with local artwork creating an intimate atmosphere perfect for live performances.

Amenities

The venue offers 28 local beers on tap at affordable prices plus wine from Yellowstone Valley Winery and non-alcoholic options. The space features vintage brick walls and high ceilings creating an artist-friendly environment. Under new management as of late 2024 Craft Local continues its mission to develop and support local talent.

title: Jazz Jam @ Levity Bar and Bistro
event_description: An elegant Wednesday night jazz jam featuring a rotating group of local musicians led by the house band. The rhythm section includes Lloyd Marsh on drums Robin Martinez on bass and Joe Sullivan on piano with guest artists each week. Musicians are welcome to bring instruments and sit in.
venue_address: 1027 Shiloh Crossing Blvd Suite 8 Billings MT 59102
hosts: Joe Sullivan Lloyd Marsh Robin Martinez
event_venue_information:
About Levity Bar and Bistro

Levity Bar and Bistro offers a unique Mediterranean dining experience in the Shiloh Crossing area combining fine food wine and live music in an intimate setting. The venue has become a favorite destination for date nights and sophisticated evenings out in Billings.

Jazz Night

Every Wednesday night from 7-9 PM Levity hosts a jazz jam that draws crowds of all ages. The atmosphere is romantic and upscale with comfortable seating and an inviting ambiance. The venue fills up early so arriving by 7 PM is recommended to secure seating.

Dining and Drinks

The bistro menu features Mediterranean-inspired dishes including build-your-own salads stone fire pizzas cheese and meat boards and bistro starters. An extensive wine selection complements the culinary offerings. The venue provides ample parking in the shopping area.

Entertainment

In addition to the Wednesday jazz jam Levity Bar and Bistro regularly features live music on weekends and special events. The venue maintains a family-friendly atmosphere while offering gaming options in the casino section.
